name: shramko-motor-autostart-site
description: Shramko Motor Autostart web configurator: connect a Betaflight flight controller over USB (Web Serial), edit the motor autostart settings, save them to the board and watch the motor live - in the browser.

scripts.test:fc: node --import tsx --test tests/msp.test.ts tests/cli.test.ts tests/settings.test.ts tests/simple.test.ts tests/live.test.ts tests/transport.test.ts tests/device.test.ts tests/fcnode.test.ts tests/i18n-tool.test.ts
scripts.build: node web/scripts/gen-pages.mjs && tsc -p . && vite build && node web/scripts/post-build.mjs
